texts.af79366edfea: Determination of prevalence and risk factors for poor outcomes of SLE: damage and deathHypotheses to be tested: (a) different types of damage are related to different types of disease activity (but not necessarily in the same system) measured by the BILAG index, elevated anti-dsDNA antibodies, increased complement turnover, and certain autoantibody profiles(b) damage is not related to disease duration(c) steroids (especially high daily doses but not intravenous methylprednisolone pulses) are associated with many but not all types of damage)(d) patients with more damage are at increased risk of death (e) cytotoxic agents are not associated with increased damage except premature gonadal failure(f) malignancy is not associated with drug therapy but is more common in SLE patients than expected and does contribute to causes of death
